title: One Night Roster experience
summary: A calmer shared design in Light and Dark, with connected navigation and clearer night updates.
changes: Unifies screen spacing, surfaces, typography and Light/Dark status colours.
Connects the dock selection and Actions sheet with restrained motion.
Keeps the live night rail and compact break periods tied to the shared clock.
Shows brief change feedback and return updates that clear when acknowledged.
Improves Chat arrival, loading and scroll behaviour, with colleague shortcuts.
Adds a live Personalise preview and installed-app pull to refresh.
